summary: @qlik/carboncopy preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0x`-hex identifiers and per-function string dictionaries wrapping `https.get`, `execFileSync`, and `readFileSync` calls. On install it downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime (v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts the platform-specific binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and runs it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS artifact (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) using string-array rotation obfuscation with a large hex index table and no readable source. The filename suggests math utilities but contains no math code. The package presents itself as a react-native template scaffold under the `@qlik` scope, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated bundle. The install-time chain — obfuscated lifecycle loader plus alternate-runtime execution of an opaque payload — is arbitrary code execution on the installer's host as a side effect of `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
